thread:
oliver: quick PSA 1: docusaurus build started failing on permalink fragments for pages migrated from the legacy site. linkcheck shows a mismatch between in-page anchors and generated ids.

pat: example?

oliver: on /reference/sdk/snippets.md we had a heading `## Examples (Python)` which in old docusaurus was `#examples-python` but new build emits `#examples-python-1` because there9s a duplicate slug created by an adjacent inline code fence section.

meera: ah I've seen that; code fences with heading-like first lines can pollute the slug map. the markdown-it slugger increments duplicates.

docs-bot: linkcheck: 7 broken fragment references across /reference/sdk/*.md

yun: two-pronged approach: 1) sanitize code fences so leading tokens don't influence slug generation (strip faux headings inside code blocks before slugging), 2) add a redirect map for known old anchors to new ids during build.

oliver: I prefer fix-in-source where possible. small script idea: for fenced blocks, ensure the first line if it matches heading pattern gets prefixed with a zero-width-space so it doesn't register as duplicate when slugging.

pat: zero-width-space feels hacky. redirect map is clearer and auditable. We can auto-generate redirects from the old slugifier rules for migration pages.

meera: auto-gen redirect sound good as a stopgap. I'll prototype code-block normalization and a generator that outputs a simple JSON map old->new for the plugin to consume.

docs-bot: CI: created branch docs/snippet-anchor-fix, running build.

yun: please also add a test: load the migrated page, run the slugger, assert expected mapping. prevents regressions when we reformat snippets.

meera: added test and pushed branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4281

oliver: ran locally: linkcheck failures drop 7 -> 1 (remaining one is an external link to an old blog anchor we can't control).

pat: LGTM. let's ship both: the code-block sanitization as the source fix and the redirect map as transient mitigation. Add a short note in the migration docs about code-block-first-lines and potential duplicate slugs.

docs-bot: CI passed for PR #4281. deploy queued.

yun: merged and published. live site: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-24. I spot-checked the SDK snippets page and anchors resolved.

oliver: thanks y'all. closing thread. :rocket:
